# Thu Le

> Personal website of Thu Le, a product designer based in Saigon, Vietnam.

Thu Le is a product designer who leads product design at a B2B SaaS startup in the private markets space.

This is her personal website where she shares writing on intentional living, productivity, tools, and everyday life.

## Main sections

- [About](https://thu-le.com/about): About Thu, how to connect, and site colophon
- [Blog](https://thu-le.com/blog): Personal essays and reflections
- [Now](https://thu-le.com/now): What she's currently focused on
- [Uses](https://thu-le.com/uses): Tools and software she uses
- [Links](https://thu-le.com/links): Various links and resources
- [Blogroll](https://thu-le.com/blogroll): Blogs she follows and recommends

## Notable posts

- [Personal manifesto](https://thu-le.com/blog/personal-manifesto): Her guiding principles for life and work
- [Why I rebuilt this site](https://thu-le.com/blog/why-i-rebuilt-this-site): The story behind starting this blog
- [How I track my finances](https://thu-le.com/blog/how-i-track-my-finances): Her multi-layered finance tracking system
- [On running](https://thu-le.com/blog/on-running): Reflections on running as a practice
- [Good work](https://thu-le.com/blog/good-work): Her evolving definition of meaningful work
- [50 things I learned in 2025](https://thu-le.com/blog/50-things-i-learned-in-2025): Annual learnings roundup
